Two scratch compiles closed the research's open questions in under 2 s each: (1) phase 1 strengthened+stated theorems compile with the [DecidableEq sig.preds] binder genuinely consumed (instance search finds Fintype (KType sig k); no Fintype.ofFinite, no nolints entry needed); (2) phase 2's keystone -- a segment with the k-type (k>=1) of a nonempty constant block is a nonempty constant segment -- compiles via k_equiv_monotone + k_equiv_preserves_sentence with two depth-1 sentences, axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

Plan narrows the dispatch's phase-2 statement: the general transport lemma is landed as the shrink direction only (InFamily c -> InFamily (deleteRun c s p)) under an explicit hypothesis that the constant run lies inside ONE segment of the factorization, at threshold m0 + p; the lengthen direction and the unconditioned general statement (whose honest threshold is 3*(m0+p), per report F6) are recorded as non-goals. Phase 3 needs only the shrink direction.
